source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original printed CLI, PDF671–673
input_requirements: chart_A: independently established birth data, local time and timezone with source quality
chart_B: separately established independent birth input and birth-time quality
historical fixed tropical zodiac / houses / essential-dignity chart geometry must be frozen before dyad outputs
original directional lord-Aspects, reception, planetary friendship and house swaps must be computed deterministically before seeing pair history
asymmetry_to_preserve: Saturn and Venus friend/enemy sets may not be symmetric
Mars calls Venus a friend while the source explicitly denies Venus reciprocates Mars
Each person's Ascendant lord may apply/receive differently, so A-to-B rating is not automatically B-to-A
Two same-sign contacts and different chart times may produce multiple contradictory testimonies
alternative_success_claims_prohibited: Do not use one party's retrospective positive feeling to excuse the other party's predeclared negative result
Do not choose loyalty/benefit/conflict/romance after participant answers to claim a 'hit'
Do not classify a person as violent, manipulative, disloyal, immoral, dangerous, abusive or likely to harm anyone from natal astrology
Do not compare same people's birth chart or actual known couple without a frozen held-out dyad outcome and exact null/denominator
needs_frozen_nulls: matched date/time/age/geography/sex and opportunity/control charts to estimate chance of apparent compatibility
label/permutation null over pairs, and socioeconomic/education/language/contact context baselines
balanced real concordant/discordant dyad labels with fully specified missing data and consent
